newsitem.title: USA: Remington Products sees Q4 oper earnings lower.
newsitem.headline: Remington Products sees Q4 oper earnings lower.

text.p: Remington Products Co said Tuesday it foresaw operating earnings for its fourth quarter falling to about $8 million due to weak sales, among other problems.

Remington, one of the world's leading manufacturers and marketers of men's and women's electrical personal care appliances like razors, said certain "non-cash inventory adjustments" could reduce reportable operating earnings by up to $2 million. It blamed lower shaver sales, lower average pricing of shaver products and lower unit volumes in certain personal care lines, among other things.
Remington did not say how its forecast compared with results for the same period last year.
Its third quarter operating profit fell to $4.5 million from $8.4 million for the same period in 1995, according to preliminary results.
